description: Defines the 'Note' class, a data model for representing a note with properties like id, title, content, timestamps, and pinned status. Includes methods for copying, serialization/deserialization, and formatted date display.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A simple note model with id, title, content, createdAt, updatedAt, and pinned flag.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current note with optional new values for its properties.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Serializes the note instance into a Map for database storage.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Creates a Note instance from a Map retrieved from the database.

methods.name: subtitleTime
methods.description: Provides a formatted string of the updatedAt timestamp, showing 'Today' if recent, otherwise a full date.
